name: signature-dark
notes: Gold / pink / ink in a masthead layout, dark page: the same full-bleed gold masthead and 3 px ink rule, then an ink page with cream type (the palette's rhythm: gold ground with ink type, ink ground with cream type and gold accents). Raised surfaces (code box, rule chips, notes) are night #11162B; lines are a warm grey. Pink is the masthead numeral only plus the hero's press ring and caption. Contrast on ink: cream 16.8, secondary 11.7, muted 7.3, gold 12.0; on night: gold 11.1, muted 6.7. Chart tokens are the default palette, validated on white, NOT on ink: use the default theme for data emails.
